systems.system: terminaux numériques (smartphone with ONECI's civil status data collection software)
systems.platform: smartphone running data collection software developed by ONECI
systems.tiers: health facilities of the Tonkpi region: 283 terminals handed over on 2026-08-11; health staff enter the birth and it is transmitted in real time to the civil status office (town hall or sub-prefecture)

note: The terminal is used by health staff in health facilities, who capture the birth and transmit it to the Bureau d'état civil, which handles the declaration: notification, not the office's own registration system, so no fact. The parent's national identity card fills the identity data on the terminal.
